derivations.review_note: Dal makhani, home style: INDB OSR139 as coded, with its butter and low-fat cream as written (founder oil default), and its 960 ml of water simmered down so the dish has the 74.7% water CoFID 12-468 measured in UK home urad dal (Leeds, 5 homes). OSR139's two coding errors (whole urad coded as split B003; '1 inch ginger' coded as dried ground ginger G554) are kept as coded: fixing them is a recipe edit (about -2%). No restaurant row: restaurant meals get the +5 g oil rule. Confidence C (an external moisture anchor from a different dish; a home weighing would lift it).

derivations.review_note: Poha: INDB BFP044 plus the soak water its sibling BFP045 lists (60 ml per 40 g flakes), with the oil cut so the dish's fat is the Pune kanda pohe's share of dry matter (lab 99, 11.7%). The rule pins total fat, not oil: BFP044's peanut, which the lab dish does not have (it has coconut), carries 58% of that fat, so the implied oil (1.34 g per 40 g poha) is likely leaner than the lab cook's. Supersedes the raw-mix row (294.5 kcal, no water). Cross-checked against NIN's 270 kcal per cup of 50 g dry poha. Confidence C (recipe with an anchor-only fat rule, no moisture anchor).
